relations.zotero_refs: Author according to [8H6M69W4], No.16172: shAkya'i dge slong chos kyi seng+ge

comments:
The same scholar, identified in the colophon as "dharma singha" (=Tib. chos kyi seng ge) composed this commentary on the Mūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikāvṛtti (ID:3766) and a commentary on the Mūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikā (ID:3764), see (ID:5524).
He is likely the same person who composed a So thar mdo'i 'grel ba (ID:4507), whose colophon likewise names the author "dharma singha."

Whether the author is Phya pa Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3831) remains to be confirmed, notably upon systematic comparison with another commentary on the °kārikā titled dGe tshul rnams kyi bslab pa'i rim pa ston pa'i rnam par bshad pa (ID:4511), the colophon of which names the author "chos kyi seng ge" and indicates he was a disciple of Bya 'dul (ID:3818).
Other candidates for the authorship, see (ID:6566), Phya pa's students (ID:3844) and (ID:3853).

The expression bu ta / 'bu ta is frequently used instead of sangs rgyas (pa).
Numerous references to anonymous other thinkers.
